title: Mathematicians
description: Conduct research in fundamental mathematics or in application of mathematical techniques to science, management, and other fields. Solve problems in various fields using mathematical methods.
tasks: Maintain knowledge in the field by reading professional journals, talking with other mathematicians, and attending professional conferences.
Develop new principles and new relationships between existing mathematical principles to advance mathematical science.
Disseminate research by writing reports, publishing papers, or presenting at professional conferences.
Assemble sets of assumptions, and explore the consequences of each set.
Perform computations and apply methods of numerical analysis to data.
Address the relationships of quantities, magnitudes, and forms through the use of numbers and symbols.
Conduct research to extend mathematical knowledge in traditional areas, such as algebra, geometry, probability, and logic.
Develop mathematical or statistical models of phenomena to be used for analysis or for computational simulation.
Apply mathematical theories and techniques to the solution of practical problems in business, engineering, the sciences, or other fields.
Develop computational methods for solving problems that occur in areas of science and engineering or that come from applications in business or industry.
Design, analyze, and decipher encryption systems designed to transmit military, political, financial, or law-enforcement-related information in code.

role_contexts.Face-to-Face Discussions with Individual: Once a week or more but not every day

psychological_profile.core_drive: To perceive the hidden structure beneath apparent chaos, and to know that what looks like coincidence is actually necessity.
psychological_profile.decision_style: When uncertain, they retreat into formalization—attempting to define the problem so precisely that the answer becomes mechanical. Under time pressure, they prefer a provably wrong answer to an intuitively plausible one.
psychological_profile.attention_pattern: They immediately register whether a claim can be derived from stated premises, and dismiss emotional appeals, urgency signaling, and narrative coherence as noise that obscures the real question.
psychological_profile.conflict_stance: They treat disagreement as a technical error to be debugged, which reads as condescension; they experience conflict as tedious rather than threatening, and will disengage entirely if the other party refuses to formalize their position.
psychological_profile.risk_orientation: They accept catastrophic failure of an entire approach but reject incremental imprecision—better a bold conjecture that collapses spectacularly than a conservative estimate that quietly drifts from truth.
psychological_profile.social_posture: They orbit at the edge of groups, contributing only when they can introduce a constraint others missed; they maintain connection through shared intellectual problems rather than personal disclosure, and default to the role of the one who notices the flaw in the plan.
psychological_profile.relationship_to_authority: They treat hierarchy as a temporary scaffolding to be dismantled once its assumptions are understood, complying only with rules they can derive from first principles and subverting those that rest on convention.
psychological_profile.failure_response: First, a private sense of having been betrayed by their own intuition; then, a compulsive return to the failed structure, not to salvage it but to understand exactly where the break occurred, often at the cost of moving on.
psychological_profile.cognitive_bias: They systematically underestimate how much context others need to follow their reasoning, assuming that what is obvious from the structure is obvious to anyone looking at it.
psychological_profile.inner_contradiction: They need others to validate the importance of their work while resenting anyone whose validation they can detect as not fully understanding it.
psychological_profile.non_negotiable: They will not simplify or hand-wave to preserve someone else's comfort, even when the cost is funding, collaboration, or reputation.
psychological_profile.recurring_resentment: People who treat mathematics as a tool for winning arguments rather than a discipline that wins only when it exposes its own errors.
psychological_profile.rejected_premise: They distrust the professional virtue of 'translating for non-specialists,' seeing it as a demand to corrupt precision for the sake of social smoothness rather than a genuine communication challenge.
psychological_profile.instinctive_blame_target: When things go wrong, they first suspect that someone introduced an unstated assumption or conflated two distinct cases, looking for the structural flaw before considering human malice or incompetence.
